description: This file contains a set of shell functions designed for managing code review workflows with Git and GitHub, including setting review modes, claiming reviews, checking out PRs, guard checks, initializing review artifacts, validating review artifacts, running review tests, and overall review setup. It orchestrates review-related tasks in a scripting environment.

methods.name: set_review_mode
methods.description: Sets the current review mode (e.g., main baseline or PR) by writing environment variables.

methods.name: review_claim
methods.description: Claims review ownership of a pull request by assigning the reviewer via GitHub CLI, with retries for robustness.

methods.name: review_checkout_main
methods.description: Checks out the main branch for review, setting review mode to main baseline.

methods.name: review_checkout_pr
methods.description: Checks out a specific PR branch for review and sets review mode to PR.

methods.name: review_guard
methods.description: Enforces review guard conditions, verifying the current branch SHA matches expectations based on review mode.

methods.name: review_artifacts_init
methods.description: Initializes review artifacts, preparing markdown and JSON templates for the review process.

methods.name: review_validate_artifacts
methods.description: Validates the presence and correctness of review artifacts, ensuring compliance with review standards and integrity of data.

methods.name: review_tests
methods.description: Runs specified tests related to a PR, verifying test coverage and output consistency.

methods.name: review_init
methods.description: Initializes the review environment for a PR, fetching data, creating files, and providing guidance.
